rules: Each episode locks to exactly one point-of-view faction for its full runtime.
The POV soldier and every nearby friendly soldier must belong to the selected friendly faction.
Nearby friendly uniforms, helmets, weapons, web gear, vehicles, defensive positions and movement direction must be historically consistent with that faction and episode.
Enemy troops may appear only as the clearly opposing force and must be separated by geography, distance, cover, trench line, ridge, street frontage or attack axis.
If the enemy is not clearly needed, prefer no visible enemy rather than ambiguous mixed soldiers.
Quiet, recovery and observation scenes must preserve the same faction continuity as combat scenes.
Historical plausibility and faction readability take priority over spectacle.

episodes.friendlyVisualIdentity: 1944 U.S. Army infantry uniforms, M1 helmets, U.S. web gear, M1 rifles and landing equipment
episodes.enemyVisualIdentity: German defenders remain in bunkers, bluff strongpoints or opposing positions
episodes.battlefieldGeometry: U.S. troops move from landing craft and beach inland; German defenders remain above and inland from beach
episodes.generationLock: POV and nearby troops are U.S. Army only; German defenders remain clearly separate.
